quality: manifest-matching TTO 0.2.4 native replay, original target isolation, control eligibility, input validity and original TTL; execution continue policy never overrides model eligibility
segments: only genuine input/source/control gaps; never request or phase boundaries

initialization.method: existing fixed-dynamics affine past-TJ prefix estimate
initialization.E_policy: first legal 60s prefix once per run/model, then fixed; rank-weak fallback median original training E
initialization.A_long: two-state free response after prefix within each strict segment; no subsequent TJ feedback
initialization.causal_state: original rolling past60 with fixed E; Tf anchors current TJ, not a prediction
initialization.filters: same primary G2 QS and LP30/LP120; real irregular dt/left held inputs; no cross-gap carry

clock.strict_alignment: unavailable: no established instrument clock uncertainty bound
clock.nominal_display: interpret original instrument calendar digits as user-set Asia/Shanghai, offset 0, approximate only
clock.scenario_selection: none; all reported, no temperature correlation or drift fit

reference: one instrument row at or immediately after resident-baseline actual start +150s under nominal display, fixed across all models/scenarios; if its model qualification is absent report unavailable, never choose replacement
surface_comparison: local uncalibrated fin contact only; absolute and single-reference delta descriptions, not Ts accuracy or thermal capacity
TJ_diagnostics: primary four-state A-roll and B-HOLD plus B0/B1, independent labels/common sets and coverage; no future load predictor
mutations_allowed: new research directory and derived artifacts only; no production, original, model, device or git writes
